title: Sixteen Improved Bounds on Quantum Error-Correcting Codes via Quasi-Twisted and Bordered Hermitian Constructions
description: Explicit Hermitian self-orthogonal linear codes over GF(q^2) constructing ten pure quantum stabilizer codes ([[36, 26, 4]]_2, [[49, 33, 5]]_2, [[20, 10, 5]]_3, [[18, 6, 6]]_4, [[19, 7, 6]]_4, [[20, 10, 5]]_4, [[25, 15, 5]]_4, [[26, 16, 5]]_4, [[19, 7, 6]]_5, and [[21, 7, 7]]_7) that strictly improve 16 minimum-distance lower bounds (closing 5 entries to exact optimality) in Markus Grassl's CodeTables.de over alphabets q in {2, 3, 4, 5, 7}. Includes full manuscript (PDF/LaTeX), Magma verification script, JSON certificates with SHA-256 digests, RTX 3090 CUDA / Rust search solvers, and zero-shared-code clean-room verifiers.
